page.overview:
What is Slateport City?

Slateport City is a city on the southern coast of Hoenn. A fresh market formed because of the abundance of food and clean water in the area. It soon blossomed into a harbor with a lighthouse in the south that lights the way for ships passing and coming into the harbor.

There are three entrances to Slateport City, the northern entrance being Route 110. The southern entrance being Route 109, and to the east is Route 134.

The Slateport market is a unique place by itself.

Players can get items here which cannot be found easily.
